headline: [Shock Collapse!] India All Out for [89] as New Zealand Win by 244 Runs
sub: Matt Henry takes 6 wickets, Will Young hits 125
caption:
🏏 India All Out for 89 as New Zealand Win by 244 Runs

New Zealand beat India by 244 runs in the fourth ODI at Bay Oval, Mount Maunganui, on Friday. New Zealand made 333, and India were bowled out for just 89 in reply.

🔹 Fast bowler Matt Henry took 6 wickets for 27 runs. Reuters reported he took three wickets in his first over, including Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli.
🔹 Will Young scored 125 from 108 balls, his fifth ODI hundred.
🔹 India still lead the five-match series 2-1 (the third match was washed out by rain). The last match is on Sunday at the same ground.
